A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.

A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

On jumping was crowded by KING ALLOY which shifted in.  H Bentley stated that after commencing well he elected to go forward to attempt to cross runners to his inside.  He said when GIMME FIVE held its position to his inside ALWAYS FLUKE was obliged to race very wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  He said as a result ALWAYS FLUKE did not respond to his riding in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
E C W Wong was reprimanded for using his whip on a horse that was clearly out of contention.
From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  J Orman was reprimanded for using his whip on a horse that was clearly out of contention.

Jumped only fairly, shifted out and lost ground when it made contact with ONESHOT.  Near the 1000 Metres became unbalanced when it shifted in and away from ONESHOT.  Crowded near the 800 Metres.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Bumped heavily at the start.  Crowded near the 800 Metres.

Bumped heavily at the start.  A Atzeni (MASTER LUCKY) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 800 Metres he allowed his mount to shift in when insufficiently clear of CASA BUDDY, resulting in CASA BUDDY being crowded in onto ONESHOT which was checked to avoid CASA BUDDY and as a result blundered and then shifted in and crowded the running of CHIU CHOW GOLF.  A Atzeni was suspended from riding in races for one Hong Kong raceday to be conducted on Wednesday, 20 May 2026 at Happy Valley.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his very good race riding record.  L Ferraris (SUPER LOVE) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 300 Metres he improved to the inside of CHIU CHOW GOLF when there was not sufficient room to do so, resulting in ONESHOT being crowded for room and being checked to avoid SUPER LOVE.  L Ferraris was suspended from riding in races for one Hong Kong raceday to be conducted on Saturday, 9 May 2026 at Sha Tin.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his very good race riding record.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
